label: Instagram
summary: A short caption built from one real moment and what it means, longer than a tweet but never a summary.

slots.label: Moment
slots.description: The vivid scene, image, or specific instance the caption opens with or centers on — one occasion, not a habitual or generalized account.

slots.label: Meaning
slots.description: The reflection, feeling, or realization that follows from the moment — what it means now, or what it says about the author or the relationship.

research.basis: Instagram captions read best as a short story arc: a concrete moment first, one line of reflection after — concreteness research supports the vivid opening, and Orwell's concrete-over-abstract rule argues against padding the reflection into more than it's earned.
citations: Sadoski, Goetz & Rodriguez 2000 — concreteness effect: concrete/imageable text beats abstract text on interest and recall
Orwell, Politics and the English Language — never use an abstract word where a concrete one will do
Green & Brock 2000 — narrative transportation: imagery and affect during the scene do most of the engagement work, reflection anchors rather than drives it
